title: Numbers Bible Quiz - Chapter 25
description: Ten questions on Numbers 25: Israel joins himself to Baal Peor, Phinehas stops the plague, and Yahweh gives him a covenant of peace.

questions.text: Where was Israel staying when the people began to play the prostitute with the daughters of Moab?
questions.explanation: "Israel stayed in Shittim; and the people began to play the prostitute with the daughters of Moab."

questions.text: To whom did Israel join himself, making Yahweh's anger burn?
questions.explanation: The people ate and bowed down to their gods, and Israel joined himself to Baal Peor.

questions.text: What were the people doing at the door of the Tent of Meeting when a man brought a Midianite woman?
questions.explanation: The man brought the Midianite woman in the sight of Moses and the whole congregation while they were weeping at the door of the Tent of Meeting.

answers.text: Offering a bull and a ram

questions.text: Who rose up from the congregation and took a spear in his hand?
questions.explanation: Phinehas, the son of Eleazar, the son of Aaron the priest, saw it, rose up and took a spear in his hand.

questions.text: How many died by the plague?
questions.explanation: "Those who died by the plague were twenty-four thousand."

questions.text: What covenant did Yahweh give to Phinehas?
questions.explanation: Yahweh said, "Behold, I give to him my covenant of peace."

questions.text: What would the covenant be to Phinehas and his offspring after him?
questions.explanation: It would be "the covenant of an everlasting priesthood," because he was jealous for his God and made atonement for Israel.

answers.text: The covenant of an everlasting priesthood
A promise of a large inheritance of land
The right to be king over Israel

questions.text: To which tribe did Zimri, the man who was slain, belong?
questions.explanation: Zimri, the son of Salu, was a prince of a fathers' house among the Simeonites.

questions.text: What was the name of the Midianite woman who was slain?
questions.explanation: The Midianite woman who was slain was Cozbi, the daughter of Zur, who was head of a fathers' house in Midian.

questions.text: What did Yahweh command Moses to do to the Midianites at the end of the chapter?
questions.explanation: Yahweh said, "Harass the Midianites, and strike them," because they had deceived Israel in the matter of Peor.

answers.text: Let them pass through the land
